variants.headline: People leave the colony on the ship
variants.body: People have left the colony on the ship: young adults without work and families without homes. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.

variants.headline: Departure follows a lack of work and homes
variants.body: The ship has taken away young adults with no work and families with no home. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.

variants.headline: A ship takes settlers away
variants.body: Young adults lacking work and families lacking homes have departed the colony aboard the ship. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.
